patterns: How can I apply for on-campus housing?
Is there space available in the dorms?
When can I apply for on-campus housing?
responses: You can apply for on-campus housing through the housing portal. Availability may vary, so it's recommended to apply early.
To apply for housing, visit the housing portal on the university's website. Make sure to check for availability during your desired semester.

patterns: How much does on-campus housing cost?
How much does a dorm room cost per semester?
responses: Housing costs vary depending on the dorm type and room selection. For detailed pricing, visit the housing fee page on the university website.
On-campus housing fees differ depending on the location and amenities of the dorm. Please check the housing portal for the most current rates.

patterns: Who is eligible for on-campus housing?
Am I eligible to stay on campus as a graduate student?
responses: Typically, freshmen are guaranteed housing. Upperclassmen, graduate students, and transfer students can apply, but availability is limited.
Eligibility for on-campus housing depends on your student status and availability. Please check the housing portal for more information.

patterns: When is the housing application deadline?
What is the deadline for applying for a dorm room?
When do I need to submit my housing application?
responses: The housing application deadline typically falls in the spring for the following academic year. Please visit the housing portal for specific dates.
Make sure to submit your housing application by the specified deadline to ensure the best chance for availability. Refer to the university website for deadline updates.

patterns: When can I move into my dorm?
What time can I check into my dorm?
responses: Move-in day typically happens before the start of the semester. Check the housing portal for your specific dorm's move-in schedule.
The move-in day and time will be provided to you via email after your housing application has been processed.

patterns: What are the rules for living in the dorms?
What are the policies for on-campus housing?
Can I have visitors in my dorm?
responses: Each dorm has its own set of rules and policies, including visitor hours and alcohol policies. Make sure to review the housing handbook for details.
Dorm policies vary by building. Be sure to check the specific policies for your assigned dorm once your housing application is approved.
